e.title: 精算行业拐点
e.summary: 精算行业站在拐点（actuarialpost）：AI 时代的职业重构分析
e.body:
「The actuarial profession stands at an inflection point」（actuarialpost.co.uk）：精算行业站在拐点的分析——AI/数据技能重塑精算职业。对 RIAA：精算职业重构的分析——与 [[actuaries-ai-reckoning]]（美国 AI 清算）、[[ai-two-track-workforce]]（亚太双轨）、[[hybrid-actuarial-role]]（混合角色）互相印证：全球视角的职业拐点共识；理解「拐点」的含义（技能/岗位/价值的重构）；求职规划的战略性参考。

e.summary_hk: 精算行業站在枴點（actuarialpost）：AI 時代的職業重構分析
e.body_en:
'The actuarial profession stands at an inflection point' (actuarialpost.co.uk): an analysis of the profession at a turning point — AI/data skills reshaping the actuarial career. For RIAA: an analysis of actuarial-career restructuring — mutually corroborating [[actuaries-ai-reckoning]] (US AI reckoning), [[ai-two-track-workforce]] (APAC two-track) and [[hybrid-actuarial-role]] (hybrid roles): the global consensus of a career inflection; understand the meaning of the 'inflection' (restructuring of skills/roles/value); a strategic reference for career planning.
